mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20d returns in at least 55% of cases, or interaction IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.1% monthly increase signals active monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% monthly, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust supply-side economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to correlate with positive 20d SPX returns in at least 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 750.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 45% of instances when HOUST > 750.0, or t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate an overheating labor market that triggers inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce negative 20d returns in at least 55% of cases, or interaction IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 2.5% annualized in late-cycle expansions signals economic overheating that precedes monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03.
